purpose: Publish-safe registry for external content that Odds Genius may reference, embed, or contextualise.
principles: External sources provide raw context; Odds Genius provides the interpretation layer.
Do not republish full articles, videos, or provider-owned datasets unless the source licence explicitly permits it.
Store source URL, provider, usage mode, attribution, and freshness on every content item.

youtube_embed.allowed_use: Embed public videos via the YouTube iframe/player flow.
rules: Do not download or rehost video files.
Prefer official league, broadcaster, club, or competition channels.
Keep the YouTube player controls and attribution intact.

rss_headline_link.allowed_use: Use headline, source, timestamp, and outbound link as a signal input.
rules: Do not copy full article bodies into public pages.
Use short Odds Genius interpretation text written from the intelligence layer.
Link clearly to the original publisher.

weather_context.allowed_use: Use public or licensed weather data to create football-specific context.
rules: Keep attribution where the provider requires it.
Present weather as a contextual modifier, not a guaranteed outcome driver.

environmental_volatility.allowed_use: Use public space-weather/environmental data only as a labelled experimental volatility overlay.
rules: Keep this behind a clear experimental label until validated.

sources.notes: Use embed URLs only. Official football channels are preferred.
Useful for low-cost weather overlays. The free API is non-commercial, so production/commercial use needs an appropriate plan or confirmed permission.
Internal beta/research overlay shape for website context. This must remain soft context and must not hard-gate deploy outputs.
Experimental context only; never present as deterministic prediction logic.
Provider terms differ. Use as headline/link signal input unless a richer licence is confirmed.
